You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. jobs.title: Senior Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst
jobs.description: RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst .    About RainFocus   RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun, and exciting. About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior GRC Analyst to join our Security and Privacy team. In this role, you will own and grow RainFocus's governance, risk, and compliance program â maintaining our control framework, leading risk assessments, supporting audits, and driving the program's maturity forward rather than simply maintaining the status quo. You will report directly to the CISO and have significant ownership from day one. \n Key Responsibilities: Lead RainFocus's GRC program across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and other client/regulatory compliance frameworks, including audit prep, evidence collection, and auditor relationships.   Manage and mature our control framework, mapping new regulations and conducting gap assessments.   Own the annual security risk assessment process (NIST SP 800-30 methodology), including stakeholder interviews, risk scoring, and residual risk tracking.   Maintain and update security policies, standards, and documentation to ensure compliance with industry best practices.   Partner with Engineering and Security to mature vulnerability management and secrets-scanning practices, moving these from reactive to proactive, pre-deployment controls.   Help build out and operationalize a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) program, including policy design and rollout across email, endpoint, and cloud storage.   Grow and mature RainFocus's security awareness training program.   Drive AI governance efforts â policy, tooling, and monitoring for approved vs. unapproved AI tool usage across the company.   Identify and help close Shadow IT / unmanaged SaaS visibility gaps in partnership with IT.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement risk management practices and ensure compliance across the organization.   Respond to security and privacy inquiries from clients, partners, and employees.   Prepare and present reports on the organization's security and privacy compliance status, including program maturity and remediation progress. Stay abreast of emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and compliance requirements. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field is highly desirable. 6+ years of proven experience in GRC, IT audit, information security compliance, or a related field. In-depth knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST 800-series, GDPR, and others). Experience running or contributing heavily to formal risk assessments â not just tracking a compliance checklist. Professional certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP, or CIPM are highly desirable. Familiarity with modern security tooling such as Drata, OneTrust, Vanta, etc. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks is a plus. Experience with OneTrust or related GRC technologies is a plus.

jobs.description: The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. jobs.description: Deine Rolle Steuerberatungen rechnen rückwärts. Sie wissen genau, was im letzten Jahr passiert ist, und erstaunlich wenig darüber, welches Mandat, welche Leistung und welcher Mitarbeiter morgen Geld verdient. Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis. Wir wachsen organisch und durch Übernahmen weiterer Einheiten. Beides erzeugt dieselbe Frage in zwei Formen: Was verdienen unsere Mandate, Leistungen und Teams tatsächlich — und was folgt daraus für die nächsten zwölf Monate. Du kommst aus der Strategieberatung oder aus Transaction Services — Bain, McKinsey, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman oder eine der Deal-Advisory-Einheiten der Big Four. Du hast Due Diligences gerechnet, Pricing-Projekte gemacht oder Ergebnisprogramme aufgesetzt. Was dich stört: Dein längstes Projekt lief wenige Monate, und du hast nie gesehen, was aus deinen Empfehlungen wurde. Du willst umlenken, wenn etwas nicht trägt, und beim nächsten Mal wissen, was anders zu machen ist. Bei Vogel findest du das Gegenteil dieser Taktung — Strukturen, die tragen, und eine Aufgabe, die nicht endet, wenn der Bericht abgegeben ist. Du verantwortest die finanzielle Steuerung von der Ertragsseite her: was unsere Mandate, Leistungen und Teams produzieren, was die übernommenen Bestände wirklich verdienen, und was daraus für die kommenden Quartale folgt. Die Abläufe baust du dabei nicht selbst um — du siehst auf die Zahlen, erkennst, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, und gehst damit zu den Menschen, die es ändern können. So lange, bis die Wirkung in den Zahlen steht. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung; Vogel ist inhabergeführt, Joachim und Moritz Vogel entscheiden persönlich. Deine Verantwortung Wertsteigerung im Zukauf Entwickle je Übernahme den Wertsteigerungsplan auf der finanziellen Seite: Honorarniveau, Leistungszuschnitt, Zuständigkeiten und Mitarbeiterstruktur — welche Hebel, in welcher Reihenfolge, mit welchem erwarteten Ergebnis und zu welchem Zeitpunkt es sichtbar sein muss. Die Prozess- und Automatisierungsseite im Tagesgeschäft liegt bei Operations, nicht bei dir. Verfolge diesen Plan über Jahre, nicht über hundert Tage — und liefere die Ist-Zahlen zurück, an denen sich zeigt, was von den Annahmen der Bewertung angekommen ist. Dein Maßstab: Die dritte Übernahme läuft besser als die erste, weil du beide gemacht hast. Arbeite in mehreren Integrationen gleichzeitig, die unterschiedlich weit sind — während die erste noch mitten in der Umsetzung steckt, kommt die nächste mit anderer Mandantenstruktur und anderen Menschen. Ertragskraft und Produktivität Durchleuchte die Bestände auf den echten Daten des laufenden Rechnungswesens — Mandatsgröße, Leistungsbezug, Honorarhöhe, Deckungsbeitrag — und mach sichtbar, was heute stillschweigend miterbracht und nicht abgerechnet wird. Erfasse und bewerte die Produktivität auf beiden Seiten: je Leistungsart, welche ihren Deckungsbeitrag trägt und welche quersubventioniert wird, und je Mitarbeiter, wo Wertschöpfung je eingesetzter Stunde entsteht und wo nicht. Erkenne aus denselben Daten, wo Mandanten Leistungen brauchen, die sie heute nicht beziehen — definiere die Signale dafür und mach sie automatisiert auffindbar, statt auf das Gefühl des einzelnen Beraters zu warten. Leite aus jedem Befund unmittelbar Maßnahmen ab — Honorarhöhe, Leistungszuschnitt, Aufgabenverteilung, Automatisierung. Dein Maßstab: keine Analyse ohne benannte Maßnahme, benannten Verantwortlichen und benanntes Datum. Durchsetzung und Maßnahmensteuerung Führe die Honorargespräche selbst — mit dem Berufsträger an deiner Seite oder allein. Wer rechnet, spricht auch. Und sprich auch die unangenehmen Fälle aus: Nicht jedes Mandat hat einen Weg in die Profitabilität. Geh mit deinen Zahlen direkt zu den fachlich Verantwortlichen an den Standorte

Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Programmatic AdTech Domain Expertise: 3–4 years of Product Management experience (with at least 3 years directly in Programmatic, Ad Exchange, SSP, or DSP environments) to lead our DSP-facing ad exchange capabilities across their full lifecycle. You thrive when dissecting OpenRTB specs, auction mechanics, and mobile formats (video, playable, native, display) to turn programmatic complexities into clear product roadmaps. Technical Infrastructure & API Fluency: Hands-on comfort working alongside senior engineers to parse system architecture, API designs, JSON data payloads, and latency tracking. You will bridge technical execution with business strategy across a platform running 20+ Go microservices on Kubernetes and Kafka, orchestrating 1,500 bid requests per second. Auction Mechanics & Traffic Shaping: Deep analytical capability to optimize win rates, timeout rates, bid density, and Supply Path Optimization (SPO). You will design smart throttling and routing logic that reduces infrastructure QPS costs while maximizing revenue across 120M processed auctions daily. Cross-Functional Partner Integration: Direct technical collaboration with the Demand Partnerships team and external partners to lead DSP onboardings and maintain OpenRTB compliance. You act as the translation layer between client feedback, external demand needs, and detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs). Data-Driven Metric Ownership: Relentless focus on defining and monitoring core performance indicators including fill rate, bid rate, CPM, and eCPM. You will partner with data teams to analyze complex data sets, troubleshoot technical issues, and measure feature performance alongside ML models making 50 billion daily predictions. Agile Product Delivery: Proven track record of owning end-to-end execution, experimentation, and scaling in an Agile environment. You manage multi-stakeholder dependencies cleanly and ship high-throughput features iteratively without sacrificing low-latency requirements. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it ! Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application! jobs.title: Co-Founder/in Performance Marketing für Supplement Brand (m/w/d)gescuht
jobs.description: Wir haben eine neue Supplement Brand gegründet und suchen einen Co Founder oder eine Co Founderin, der oder die gemeinsam mit uns aus einem starken Produktsetup eine skalierbare D2C Brand aufbaut. Das Fundament steht bereits: Brand, Shop und grundlegendes Setup sind fertig, unsere ersten Produkte befinden sich in den letzten Zügen der Entwicklung und ein vielversprechender Produzent mit sehr hohem Qualitätsanspruch steht im Hintergrund. Du steigst also nicht ganz am Anfang einer langen Produktentwicklungsphase ein, sondern zu einem Zeitpunkt, an dem wir zeitnah in den Markt starten können. Gleichzeitig bist du früh genug dabei, um aktiv Einfluss auf Produkte, Positionierung, Offers und die gesamte Growth Strategie zu nehmen. Aufgaben Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Growth und Performance Marketing. Gemeinsam wollen wir herausfinden, welche Positionierung, Creatives, Offers und Funnels funktionieren und daraus Schritt für Schritt eine skalierbare Brand bauen. Dazu gehören unter anderem: • Aufbau und Skalierung unserer Performance Marketing Aktivitäten • Paid Social mit Fokus auf Meta • Entwicklung und Testing von Creatives, Offers, Funnels und Landingpages • Analyse und Optimierung der wichtigsten E Commerce KPIs • Entwicklung neuer Growth Ansätze und Testing Strategien • Aktiver Input zu Positionierung, Produkt und Customer Journey • Operativer Aufbau der Brand gemeinsam mit uns Dabei erwarten wir nicht, dass du bereits zehn Brands auf Millionenumsätze skaliert hast. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du extrem lernwillig bist, schnell Zusammenhänge verstehst, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und wirklich Lust hast, dich tief in das Thema einzuarbeiten. Qualifikation Du solltest bereits erste praktische Berührungspunkte mit D2C, E Commerce oder Performance Marketing gehabt haben und verstehen, wie eine digitale Consumer Brand grundsätzlich funktioniert. Wichtig sind uns vor allem: • Erste Erfahrung im D2C oder E Commerce Umfeld • Grundverständnis von Performance Marketing und Paid Social • Starkes Interesse an Creatives, Funnels, Offers und Conversion Optimierung • Hohe Lernbereitschaft und der Anspruch, schnell besser zu werden • Analytisches und unternehmerisches Denken • Hands on Mentalität und Lust, selbst umzusetzen • Affinität zu Supplements, Proteinprodukten, Nutrition und dem Markt Du musst noch nicht alles können. Du solltest aber den Anspruch haben, es zu lernen und in diesem Bereich richtig gut zu werden. Warum der Zeitpunkt spannend ist Die zeitintensive Grundlagenarbeit ist bereits weitgehend gemacht. Shop steht. Brand steht. Produktion steht. Die ersten Produkte stehen kurz vor der Finalisierung. Gleichzeitig befinden wir uns noch früh genug im Prozess, dass du die Richtung der Brand aktiv mitbestimmen kannst. Der nächste große Schritt ist jetzt der Go to Market und der Aufbau eines funktionierenden Performance Marketing Systems. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Benefits Das ist keine klassische Festanstellung, sondern eine unternehmerische Co Founder Rolle mit Unternehmensanteilen. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, in ein weit fortgeschrittenes Setup einzusteigen und von Beginn an Verantwortung für einen der wichtigsten Bereiche der Brand zu übernehmen. Wir suchen jemanden, der Lust darauf hat, nicht einfach Performance Marketing für die nächste Brand zu machen, sondern selbst an einer beteiligt zu sein und sie langfristig mit aufzubauen. Wenn du bereits erste D2C Erfahrung gesammelt hast, Performance Marketing spannend findest und richtig Bock darauf hast, dich in einen Case reinzubeißen und gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen, sollten wir sprechen. Freuen uns über jede Bewerbung um gemeinsam eine coole Marke aufzubauen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You'll build the systems that make that real: agentic pipelines, MCP servers, and internal tools that change how we operate day-to-day, not in some future roadmap. You'll report to Florent (Head of Operations & Energy) and work within a team of amazing people alongside. Your mission Design, build, and ship end-to-end agentic systems, RAG pipelines, embeddings, retrieval, prompt engineering, and evaluation, that automate Cloover's highest-volume internal workflows. Build and deploy custom MCP servers and integrations connecting HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Aircall, and other tools, so data flows where it needs to without manual work in between. Write production-grade Python and TypeScript with sound schema design, security, and authorization, code that ships and runs, not prototypes that sit. Own internal tooling end-to-end: spot the gap, build the tool, and deploy it on Firebase, Vercel, or GCP with proper version control and CI/CD. Build custom Claude Code skills, plugins, and connectors, then onboard colleagues into AI-native workflows that they actually keep using. Partner with Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, and Finance to identify the highest-leverage automation use cases, then personally implement them. Your profile We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role: You've shipped agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or AI-powered tools, in school, side projects, hackathons, or work, not just experimented with prompts in a chat window. You write production-grade Python and/or TypeScript and can defend the trade-offs in your code. You're comfortable wiring REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication across third-party tools (HubSpot, Slack, Notion, or similar) and can model data sensibly. You identify the gap, scope the solution, and ship it without waiting to be told what to do. Based in Berlin and energized by being in the room. We're intentionally office-first, decisions get made in real time, prototypes get stress-tested over lunch, and the founding team is ten meters away. If that's how you thrive, you'll feel at home here. Nice to have (but not required): Hands-on experience with MCP, Claude Code, or agentic frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or Google ADK. German language proficiency (B1 or above), useful for collaborating with the Ops & Energy team. Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Most go from first call to offer in under three weeks. Intro call (30 min) — We want to understand what you're looking for, not just screen your CV. Hiring manager interview (30 min) — We go deep: your experience, your thinking, how you approach problems. Case study (1 hour) — You get the brief in advance. We care about your approach, not whether you land on the right answer. Offer & signed contract. Need any adjustments at any stage? Just let us know. Why us? Competitive pay. Fair compensation for your time and contribution, benchmarked to the Berlin internship market. AI-first & unthrottled. Unlimited enterprise-grade AI, no caps, no approval process. Every role, every team. The grunt work disappears so you can focus on what actually requires human judgement. Real ownership on a real mission. From day one you're shaping decisions that impact thousands of installers. We're not just building software, we're powering the energy transition across Europe. Grow faster than anywhere else. You'll work directly alongside the founding team and world-class investors. If you're building toward your own venture one day, there's no better room to be in. The basics, done well.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Acquisition - Munich, Germany
jobs.description: The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies. Overview We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us. What You'll Do Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform. Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models. Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products. An Ideal Candidate Should Have BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field. 5+ years of industry experience in software development. Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP) Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. What we offer A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product. An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle. A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work. An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry. Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture. Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use. Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more. Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio. The Germany Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience. Think you're a good fit for this job?  Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn. Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?  Refer them!  Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.  Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Find Jo

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist (Hospitality), German speaking- all genders
jobs.description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place. Lightspeed is looking for a Technical Specialist, Strategic Accounts in Berlin. You will be mostly focused on K-Series, report into the Strategic Support Services Team Lead and will be an important part of our global hospitality support organization. Our Strategic Support Services team oversees the Lightspeed Strategic Accounts support experience. This group partners with Senior Support + Strategic Accounts Management to quarterback the service experience for our most valuable and complex merchants. What the Role involves Deliver Premium Support: Provide exceptional technical assistance and white-glove customer service to Strategic Accounts via email, phone, video, and on-site engagements. Optimize Business Processes: Proactively identify opportunities to recommend best practices, helping high-value clients streamline operations and maximize the value of the Lightspeed ecosystem. Facilitate Seamless Transitions: Partner with Implementation teams to execute successful "warm handoffs," ensuring a consistent and smooth experience for new Strategic accounts. Strengthen Account Partnerships: Collaborate closely with Strategic Account Managers (SAMs) to manage daily operations, resolve complex issues, and elevate the overall customer journey. Anticipate Client Needs: Lead unified customer meetings alongside SAMs to review ongoing requests, forecast future requirements, and mitigate risks before they escalate. Drive Features Adoption: Conduct proactive account health syncs (remote or on-site) to advocate for feature adoption that translates into measurable business growth for the client. Provide Training Sessions: Ensure our Strategic customers continue to fully utilise the potential of our software by providing training to new and existing staff members. Influence Product Strategy: Synthesize deep insights into client business challenges to advocate for product enhancements, liaising directly with Product and Development teams to refine the user experience. Escalation Management: Manage high-stakes technical escalations end-to-end—overseeing technical resolution, executive communication, and stakeholder feedback loops to ensure total customer satisfaction. Advanced Troubleshooting: Employ a comprehensive suite of diagnostic techniques to rapidly isolate the root cause of escalated issues and deliver high-impact solutions. Knowledge Management: Maintain meticulous documentation of account-specific complexities and resolutions to empower global Support teams and ensure consistent service delivery. Champion Technical Excellence: Write and maintain troubleshooting guides, testing procedures, and internal documentation while precisely tracking software defects for corrective action. Cross-Platform Mastery: Continually develop technical expertise across all Strategic Lightspeed hospitality platforms to provide versatile, high-level support. And a little bit of.... Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role. Your experience There’s many different ways to gain “experience”. People learn in different ways, skill sets can be transferred, especially when combined with a willingness to learn. If you don’t quite tick all of these boxes but think you could still absolutely smash it, send us an application anyway and let us know why you’d be amazing in this role! This role is open to candidates located in Berlin. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English (we do service multiple languages, so any others you know are a bonus!). Extensive customer service experience in a technical support role. Prior experience in the Hospitality industry. Ability to self-manage incoming emails, telephone calls, video calls, meetings, and on-site visits based on priority

jobs.description: Your new team: As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You take full responsibility for digital analytics implementations from initial requirements through to go-live and act as a trusted advisor to our clients throughout the process. What awaits you: You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts. You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers. You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection. You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues. You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process. You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development. You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working. Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients. What you can expect: At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective. You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups. You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting. What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. We want to do great work sustainably – together, with mutual support and room for different lifestyles.We are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, and enjoy sharing their expertise. We don’t see job descriptions as rigid checklists. Instead, we want to understand how your experience, interests, and strengths fit the role and what we need as a team. What you bring along: You don’t need to know every tool. What matters more is that you have a strong understanding of digital analytics and can quickly familiarize yourself with new technologies and setups. jobs.title: Research Engineer - Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy: Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models. Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models. Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance. Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably. Requirements We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring: Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines. jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you. – Alicia Strait , VP of Talent, TRM Labs As an International Sales Recruiter, you will be responsible for owning high-priority searches across EMEA and other global markets, with a focus on Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and broader business recruiting. You will partner closely with hiring managers and Talent leadership to define search strategy, map regional talent markets, engage passive candidates, and drive high-quality hiring decisions with speed and precision. Your success will be measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of hires across TRM’s international business functions. The impact you will have: Own full-cycle recruiting for international business roles across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other functions. Act as a strategic talent partner to hiring managers, advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, sourcing strategy, and closing approach. Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional talent across EMEA and other global markets. Develop regional talent maps across priority markets, including high-performing companies, competitor talent, referral-driven networks, and specialized candidate communities. Create an exceptional candidate experience, ensuring every touchpoint reflects TRM’s talent bar, mission, and operating principles. Use data, market insights, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and refine recruiting strategy in real time. Drive urgency and decision quality across searches by facilitating clear calibration, structured feedback, and timely hiring decisions. Continuously improve international recruiting processes, including intake quality, scorecard alignment, sourcing strategy, debrief rigor, and offer execution. Partner cross-functionally with Talent, People, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to navigate international hiring considerations and keep searches moving efficiently. What we’re looking for: 5+ years of recruiting experience, with strong experience supporting international business hiring in high-growth technology companies. Proven success hiring across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other business functions. Strong knowledge of EMEA talent markets, with the ability to adapt search strategy by region, function, and candidate profile. Strong search fundamentals, including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, candidate assessment, and closing. Ability to quickly understand complex business roles across GTM, compliance, marketing, operations, and other functions. Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, market data, and candidate pipeline quality, then translate insights into actionable recommendations. Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, influence hiring managers, push back thoughtfully, and operate as a strategic advisor throughout the hiring process. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. jobs.title: Payroll Manager
jobs.description: Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role We're growing our payroll bureau fast and looking for a Payroll Manager to lead a team of Payroll Specialists, driving accuracy, compliance and client experience across their portfolio. This is a people-management role: you'll coach and develop your team, own escalations, and stay hands-on with payroll when it matters. You'll also be a driving force behind automation and continuous improvement, using AI to cut manual effort and building best-practice, auditable payroll flows as you go. Responsibilities Lead, coach and develop a team of Senior Payroll Specialists, Payroll Specialists and Payroll Assistants, signing off their output before it reaches clients Act as senior point of contact for your team's client payrolls, stepping in hands-on for onboarding or escalations Advise clients directly on legislative and regulatory change, and keep the team compliant with a regular gap analysis Own the team's support ticket queue and drive continuous improvement against KPIs and SLAs Lead incident resolution and root-cause analysis, escalating major issues to the Head of Payroll Bureau Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities, and coach the team to build their own Ensure Tax Year-End processing is accurate and on time, and review the team's BACS payments Requirements Proven, hands-on experience as a Payroll Manager, including in bureau/outsourced environments with enterprise clients Strong track record coaching and developing a payroll team, combining technical knowledge with people management Comfortable managing the variability of multiple payrolls across different industries within a bureau Strong background in payroll compliance and audit, with good working knowledge of payroll/HR systems and GL structures Bonus: Republic of Ireland payroll experience, CIPP qualification (or working towards one), demonstrable use of AI to automate payroll work Benefits Salary: £70,000 - £80,000 Hybrid working - 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho) Share options 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days) Extra day of leave for every year of service Pension contributions matched up to 5% Comprehensive health insurance Enhanced parental leave & pay Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery) Annual all expenses paid team retreats The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office Professional development budget Unlimited free books Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. We're looking for an Engagement Manager to own adoption across a portfolio of mid-market corporate clients and help their in-house legal teams fundamentally change the way they work. For every account you will build a tailored roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through function-wide scaled adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. What You'll Do You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realisation for a portfolio of 15 – 20 mid-market corporates. Specifically, you will: Design each client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how that legal function adopts Legora and transforms the way it works. Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to function- and enterprise-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve. Run those programmes in parallel across the full portfolio, holding the plan, the milestones and the risks for every account and knowing at any moment which ones need your attention this week. Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands in-house legal priorities — cost, cycle time, risk and doing more without adding headcount — surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora. jobs.title: Head of Sales
jobs.description: Stora is looking for a Head of Sales to take ownership of the sales function as the business moves into its next stage of growth. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-the-sidelines one. There is already a product customers want, an established position in the UK and Ireland, growing European opportunity, and a sales team in place. The challenge now is to turn that foundation into a more predictable, repeatable commercial engine. You’ll work directly with the CEO, lead SDRs and Account Executives, improve how pipeline is created and converted, and bring greater clarity to forecasting, performance and where the next growth opportunities sit. The opportunity Stora has grown quickly, but the next stage requires more than simply doing more of what worked before. The Head of Sales will be expected to answer questions like: Where should the team focus its time and why? How does outbound become consistently productive? Where are deals getting stuck? How should SDRs and AEs be coached and developed? Which segments and markets represent the strongest opportunities? What needs to change in the sales motion as Stora moves upmarket and expands internationally? How does the business build a forecast leadership can genuinely rely on? This is a role with real authority to improve things, alongside accountability for the results. What you’ll own Sales strategy and execution Leadership, coaching and development of the SDR and AE team Outbound performance and pipeline generation Sales process from first engagement through to closed-won Forecasting, pipeline health and revenue visibility Performance management and clear expectations across the team Key and strategically important opportunities where senior involvement can make a difference Close alignment with Marketing and Product around ICP, messaging, customer insight and market opportunity You’ll also stay close to customers and deals. Stora wants a sales leader who knows what is happening on the ground, not someone whose understanding of the market comes entirely from dashboards and weekly reports. What a strong candidate looks like Stora needs a hands-on B2B SaaS sales leader who can build consistent performance, not just manage what already exists. You’re likely someone who: Has a genuine hunter mentality and knows how to create pipeline, not just manage what lands Has led and developed SaaS sales teams and can raise the standard of performance around them Knows what good outbound looks like and can coach it properly Has personally sold into SMB and/or mid-market customers and can still step into important deals when needed Builds healthier, more predictable pipeline and brings strong forecasting discipline Qualifies hard, prioritises well and is comfortable walking away from weak opportunities Uses data to improve decisions without hiding behind dashboards Challenges assumptions, spots where the sales motion is weak and acts on it Sets clear expectations, coaches directly and holds people accountable Can move comfortably between commercial strategy with the CEO, coaching the team and getting involved in a deal that matters Has the commercial instinct to spot new segments, markets or opportunities worth pursuing This is still a stage where leadership means building as well as leading. The business has established strong traction in the UK and Ireland and is continuing to expand across Europe and other international markets. jobs.description: ABOUT CODEWAY We build and publish mobile apps that reach millions fast. We've built category-leading apps time and time again. A track record proven by hits like Cleanup (#1 iPhone storage cleaner worldwide), Retake AI (#1 AI face editing app in the US), and Learna AI (the top AI language learning app globally), alongside 50+ other apps across productivity, edtech, wellness, and entertainment, all shaping the future of consumer mobile. Since launching in 2020 with a small team in Istanbul, we've grown into a 300+ person global team. With over 400 million downloads and a worldwide footprint, we're already one of the fastest-growing consumer tech companies in Europe, and join us in our next big chapter. POSITION As our Corporate FP&A Analyst - Planning, you will report directly to the Director of FP&A and sit at the ultimate strategic clearinghouse of our finance function. As our portfolio scales globally, we are building a lean, world-class decision-support function from the ground up to evaluate complex strategic options, portfolio expansions, and capital deployment choices. You will sit at the corporate level, owning the master consolidation, corporate budget, and the underlying logic for individual app-level P&Ls. This is an AI-first, digital-native finance team. We communicate via active Slack channels, build out our operational blueprints and context sharing inside Notion, and run collaboration entirely through Google Workspace. You will leverage modern workflows—initially building and auditing multi-variable models in Microsoft Excel using the Claude for Excel add-in, with a direct, subsequent mandate to act as a core product stakeholder driving our platform migration to Pigment. KEY SKILLS To excel in this role, you must bring a sharp blend of institutional corporate finance discipline, modern data literacy, and a forward-looking technology stack: Strategic Architecture: Mastery of 3-statement long-range planning (LRP), rolling monthly forecasting , and corporate top-down / bottom-up budget reconciliation. Tactical Liquidity Control: Active management of short-term cash mechanics, specifically building 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts . Next-Gen Financial Stack: Advanced driver-based Excel modeling paired with prompt engineering ( Claude for Excel ) and multi-dimensional EPM exposure ( Pigment / Anaplan). Data & Ledger Awareness: Familiarity or exposure to data systems ( Looker / BI tools) and cloud ERP structures ( NetSuite ) to collaborate effectively on data alignment. Mobile Ecosystem Domain Expertise: Deep familiarity with B2C mobile metrics ( ROAS , LTV, CAC, and cohort curves) and institutional debt facility covenant tracking. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Own the Global Planning Cycle Engine & Budget Setting: Act as the architect and coordinator of Codeway’s global budget setting and forecasting process. You will build and own the corporate top-down strategic forecasting model and lead the continuous process of coordinating and consolidating the bottom-up inputs from the FBP network. You will design, establish, and push unified planning templates out to the FBPs, running a rigorous rolling monthly forecast to keep the global corporate model perfectly synchronised with live business pacing. You will partner closely with FBPs to challenge operational assumptions, extract key variables, and align strategic direction to fuel "The Engine." Enterprise Valuation & Long-Range Planning (LRP): Build and scale corporate three-statement models and integrated multi-year cash flow frameworks explicitly designed to evaluate macro strategic options, support capital structuring, and drive long-term corporate value creation. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Platform and Partner Experience
jobs.description: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join the Partner and Platform Experience (PPX) team. You'll tackle problems where social dynamics, device ecosystems, and technical constraints intersect. It's work that demands systems thinking, deep comfort with technical complexity, and a drive to make complex interactions feel simple and engaging. Create thoughtful, polished user experiences with a strong focus on interaction design, visual craft, and the details that make an experience feel intuitive. Explore how experiences scale across mobile, desktop, TVs, speakers, cars, and other surfaces in the Spotify ecosystem. Use prototyping to explore, communicate, and test ideas, including AI-assisted and code-based approaches where they help us learn faster. Collaborate with UX Research and Insights to understand listener needs and use those insights to inform your design decisions. Work across teams, including Core Experience, to build alignment and ensure cohesiveness within the broader Spotify experience. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn. We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes. You'll help answer questions such as: Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value? Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation? What drives repeat usage, retention and churn? Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance? How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments? Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities. Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement. jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
jobs.description: <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.</p> <p>As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.</p> <p>You’ll help answer questions such as:</p> <ul> <li>Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?</li> <li>Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?</li> <li>What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?</li> <li>Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?</li> <li>How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?</li> </ul> <p>If you’re motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from <strong>acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation</strong>.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.</li> <li>Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.</li> <li>Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.</li> <li>Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.</li> <li>Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.</li> <li>Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.</li> <li>Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.</li> &l

jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering (Revenue Operations)
jobs.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering . Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it. You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter. This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace. The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV. What You'll Do Own the strategy and the stack Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together. Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself. Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams. Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback. Build, hands-on Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production. Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails. Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely. Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript. Automate across SDR, AE, and AM Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution. Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds. Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning. Take each project from prototype to production prop

jobs.title: Business Ops Intern - People & Culture (f/m/x)
jobs.description: Become a part of the 4screen team! As a Business Ops Intern – People & Culture at 4screen, you will support our team across the full employee lifecycle – from recruiting and onboarding to offboarding and beyond. You'll help optimize P&C processes, support P&C administration and contract creation, and strengthen our company culture through initiatives like team events and employer branding. In addition, you'll support taking care of our office environment, ensuring it remains a welcoming space for collaboration and wellbeing. As part of our broader Business Operations team, you'll also gain exposure to various cross-functional projects along the way, gaining valuable insights into a dynamic and innovative workplace. Tasks You will contribute to our success by: Supporting recruiting and hiring : You help manage job boards, monitor and respond to our recruiting inbox, and support candidates through the hiring process, including efforts to streamline our recruitment process. Shaping onboarding and offboarding : You own key parts of the onboarding and offboarding admin process, keep our onboarding materials up to date, support exit interviews, and help create employment references. Driving P&C administration and contracts : You support contract creation, help optimize internal and company-wide processes using AI and automation, and help collect and maintain personnel data in our P&C system (Personio). Strengthening employee experience and culture : You contribute to internal communication formats and employer branding and help organize regular team and company initiatives that strengthen cohesion and team spirit. Managing our office : You support day-to-day office management and help shape an office environment where the team feels comfortable and our culture is visible – bringing your own ideas to make it a hub for collaboration. Drive cross-functional projects : You support cross-functional projects, building skills in project planning, stakeholder management, and communication, with insight into how Business Operations functions end-to-end at a scale-up. Requirements What makes you stand out: Completed or ongoing Master's degree, ideally in Business, Economics, or a related field A genuine interest in processes, projects, and how People & Culture functions Availability for a 6-month internship Excellent German and English skills (at least B2+) Previous internship or working student experience in HR or Operations (ideally in consulting, start-up, tech, or automotive) is a plus Structured and independent working style, with strong attention to detail Hands-on and can-do mindset, comfortable owning administrative and operational tasks alongside project work Strong communication skills, initiative and an open and approachable manner A true team player with curiosity and eagerness to learn Benefits What we offer: Gain firsthand experience in a dynamic and professional startup setting Participating actively in crucial People & Culture processes and acquiring knowledge of best practices from top notch professionals Relax during your 20 days of annual leave (+ public holidays) Take care of your well-being with the support of our Egym Wellpass membership Enjoy our flexible working hours policy in our open office in Munich’s vibrant Schwabing district Have fun and enjoy the great team spirit at regular Team Events & Offsites , Pizza Nights, Game Nights, etc. About us Edit in settings 4screen is the world’s first Driver Interaction Platform , connecting brands & businesses with on-the-go customers in real time – directly through the car screen. By operating within the vehicle’s native digital interface, 4screen leverages dynamic car data to enhance the mobility experience – all in full compliance with the highest safety and privacy standards. 4screen is integrated into the operating systems of 16 leading automotive brands, including Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Hyundai, and Stel

jobs.title: HR Administrator (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Aufgaben In unserem zentralen HR-Admin-Team betreust Du die Personalprozesse mehrerer Tochtergesellschaften – von der Stammdatenpflege bis zur vorbereitenden Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung: Du übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung eigenständig die Personaladministration Deiner Betreuungsbereiche über den gesamten Employee Life Cycle Du pflegst und verwaltest die Personalstammdaten in unseren HR-Systemen und sorgst für deren Vollständigkeit und Aktualität Du begleitest strukturiert On- und Offboarding-Prozesse und erstellst die zugehörigen Dokumente Du erstellst personalbezogene Auswertungen und KPI-Reportings Qualifikation Erste Berufserfahrung in der Personaladministration, idealerweise 2 bis 5 Jahre Kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein Studium mit selbstständige Arbeitsweise Überblick und souveräne Priorisierung bei parallelen Anfragen Grundkenntnisse im Arbeits- und Sozialversicherungsrecht Serviceorientierung und klare Kommunikation Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel Verhandlungssicheres, fließendes Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Benefits Mittelstand meets Großkonzern – Wir leben das Beste aus zwei Welten, den Mittelstand mit der Lösungsorientierung und der Hands-On-Mentalität und streben zugleich nach den professionellen Standards eines Konzerns Gehalt – Unser Anspruch ist es, unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen ein attraktives und faires Gehalt zu zahlen Work-Life-Balance – Wir unterstützen unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen durch verschiedene Arbeitszeitmodelle sowie das Angebot des mobilen Arbeitens, mit allem dazu notwendigen Equipment, um Dein Privat- und Berufsleben unter einen Hut zu bekommen Perspektive – Die Welt ist im stetigen Wandel. Damit wir immer dabei sind, fördern wir die persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Kolleginnen und Kollegen und zeigen Perspektiven in der Gruppe auf Gesundheit und Fitness – Die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden unserer Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind uns wichtig, daher haben wir ein vielfältiges Gesundheitsangebot entwickelt und bieten die Nutzung von Bike-Leasing an Offene Kommunikation – Wir pflegen eine respektvolle, wertschätzende und offene Kommunikation über Hierarchieebenen hinweg Rabatte - Damit unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen bares Geld sparen können, können sie auf der Corporate Benefits Plattform alle Angebote nutzen Klingt nach Dir? jobs.title: (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche. jobs.title: Senior CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security / CSPM Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Wir sind die AJAT GmbH, ein IT und Cybersecurity Unternehmen aus Köln. Du begleitest das Projekt von der ersten Bestandsaufnahme über die Architektur und Konfiguration bis zur technischen Prüfung und Übergabe an den späteren Betrieb. Dabei geht es insbesondere um CSPM, Cloud Berechtigungen, Compliance Kontrollen, Entra ID, Reporting und den richtigen Umgang mit Findings. Aufgaben • Du analysierst gemeinsam mit uns die vorhandene AWS und Azure Umgebung des Kunden. • Du hilfst dabei, den genauen Umfang, die Ziele und die Erfolgskriterien der Einführung festzulegen. • Du entwickelst eine verständliche und technisch umsetzbare CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security Architektur. • Du bindest AWS Organizations, AWS Accounts, Azure Tenants und Azure Subscriptions an CrowdStrike Falcon an. • Du richtest die benötigten Zugriffsrechte und Cloud Berechtigungen ein. • Du achtest darauf, dass CrowdStrike nur die Berechtigungen erhält, die tatsächlich benötigt werden. • Du prüfst, ob alle vereinbarten Cloud Ressourcen richtig erkannt und dargestellt werden. • Du konfigurierst CrowdStrike CSPM passend zu den Sicherheitsanforderungen des Kunden. • Du aktivierst und prüfst CIS Benchmarks und weitere vereinbarte Sicherheitskontrollen. • Du konfigurierst Policies, Risikoschwellen, Ausnahmen und Benachrichtigungen. • Du führst die erste Bewertung der Cloud Sicherheitslage durch und besprichst die Ergebnisse mit den verantwortlichen Teams. • Du unterstützt bei der Integration von Microsoft Entra ID. • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden ein sinnvolles Rollen und Berechtigungsmodell. • Du prüfst, ob Benutzer, Gruppen und Rollen korrekt zugeordnet sind. • Du hilfst dabei, Findings nach Risiko, Kritikalität und Verantwortlichkeit zu sortieren. • Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden, welches Team welche Findings erhält und wie die weitere Bearbeitung erfolgt. • Du entwickelst passende Dashboards und Kennzahlen für Security, IT Betrieb und Management. • Du dokumentierst die vorgenommenen Einstellungen und wichtigen Entscheidungen verständlich. • Du prüfst am Ende, ob die vereinbarten Funktionen, Integrationen und Sicherheitskontrollen richtig funktionieren. • Du unterstützt bei der Behebung technischer Probleme während der Einführung. • Du bereitest die Lösung für die Übergabe an den späteren Betrieb vor. Du solltest wissen, wie AWS und Azure Umgebungen angebunden werden und wie man anschließend prüft, ob die Verbindung, Berechtigungen und Daten vollständig sind. jobs.title: (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche. Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sie als (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d) . Was Sie bei uns bewegen: Permanente Durchführung von Passform- und Qualitätskontrollen Produktionsfreigabe anhand Mustertypen Kontinuierlicher Austausch innerhalb des Produktmanagements und mit den internationalen Produktionsstätten Was uns ausmacht: Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur. Alles, was Sie zum Arbeiten benötigen: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung. Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Sie gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle und der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens können Sie Ihr Berufsleben optimal an ihr Privatleben anpassen. Mit uns profitieren Sie von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern über das Portal corporate Benefits. Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine. Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Ihr Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße. Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de. Wir feiern Erfolg und Gemeinschaft: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Team-Events und Firmenfeiern sind ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur. Was Sie ausmacht: Schuhgröße 37, Fußlänge 231 – 236 mm, durchschnittliche Fuß- und Wadenform Großes Interesse an Mode und Schuhen sowie ein starkes Bewusstsein für die Qualität von Materialien und deren Verarbeitung Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit gepaart mit guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung wünschenswert; gerne auch Quereinsteiger Hohes Engagement Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen Sie sind ein verantwortungsbewusster und äußerst engagierter Teamplayer und schätzen die konstruktive Zusammenarbeit? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. IHR KONTAKT Gülizar Yüsün HR Business Partner Wortmann KG Internationale Schuhproduktionen Personalmanagement Klingenbergstraße 1-3 32758 Detmold Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Head of Operations (m/w/d) | Health & Beauty Scale-up
jobs.description: MY HEALTH & BEAUTY ist Deutschlands erstes Health&Beauty-Startup mit dem Ziel, hochwertige ästhetische Medizin und moderne Longevity-Anwendungen für eine breite Zielgruppe zugänglich, unkompliziert, bezahlbar und flächendeckend verfügbar zu machen. Innerhalb von nur drei Jahren sind wir auf 10 Standorte und mehr als 50.000 Kunden gewachsen. Damit gehören wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmen im Bereich der ästhetischen Medizin in Deutschland. Und wir stehen erst am Anfang. In den kommenden Jahren wollen wir unseren Wachstumskurs noch deutlich beschleunigen und MY HEALTH&BEAUTY als eine der führenden Marken für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity etablieren. Deine Mission Für die nächste Phase unseres Wachstums suchen wir einen Head of Operations, der die operative Entwicklung unserer HEALTH&BEAUTY Lounges verantwortet und gemeinsam mit uns die Grundlage für die nächsten 10, 20 und oder 100 Standorte schafft. Du entwickelst Mitarbeiter und Führungskräfte weiter, gibst klares Feedback und schaffst eindeutige Verantwortlichkeiten. Du erkennst Leistungsträger frühzeitig und entwickelst sie weiter. Dabei misst du nicht nur, ob Trainings stattgefunden haben, sondern ob sie tatsächlich zu besserer Performance führen. Du entwickelst SOPs, Verantwortlichkeiten und Prozesse, die für jeden Standort klar verständlich und reproduzierbar sind.
