jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description: Coup verschafft innovativen Unternehmen einfachen Zugang zu staatlichen Fördermitteln. Dafür entwickeln wir eine leistungsstarke Softwareplattform und kombinieren sie mit exzellenter persönlicher Beratung. So wird die Beantragung und Abrechnung von R&D Förderungen für unsere Kund:innen einfach und bequem. Bei Coup sind wir der Go-to-Partner für die Beantragung und Abwicklung der Forschungszulage (FZuL) in Deutschland und haben damit seit 2021 mehr als 300 Unternehmen über 150 Mio. Euro Fördermittel gesichert. Join us and help more companies get Couped! Unser Sales war lange Founder-led. Das ändert sich jetzt. Für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase suchen wir eine kommerzielle, strukturierte Person, die unseren Outbound-Sales aufbaut, Leads konsequent durch die Pipeline führt und Deals gemeinsam mit unserem R&D Consulting Team über die Ziellinie bringt. Aufgaben Als (Sales Development Representative bist du der zweite Sales-Hire bei Coup und Teil unseres Revenue Teams, bestehend aus Marketing, Sales und Partnerships. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CRO, Theresa, und arbeitest eng mit unserem Account Executive, Maxi, sowie unserem R&D Consulting Team zusammen. Dein Ziel: Durch den systematischen Aufbau unserer Outbound-Kanäle und einer disziplinierten Pipeline-Steuerung eine skalierbare Neukundengewinnung zu etablieren, die Coup als vertrauenswürdigen Go-to-Partner für die Forschungszulage stärkt und maßgeblich zu unseren Umsatzzielen beiträgt. Deine Mission: Outbound-Aufbau & Pipeline-Ownership: Du entwickelst eigenständig Sequenzen, Playbooks und Templates für Cold Email, LinkedIn und Cold Call und setzt sie selbst um. Du ziehst deine Leadlisten eigenständig, hast die volle Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und stellst sicher, dass dir kein Lead durchs Raster fällt. Sales Calls & Qualifizierung: Du bringst Leads verlässlich in den Sales Call, erkennst den Bedarf deiner Gesprächspartner schnell und überzeugst sie davon, warum Coup der richtige Partner für sie ist. Kommerzielles Closing mit R&D Consulting: Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserem R&D Consulting Team. R&DC überzeugt fachlich-inhaltlich, du übernimmst den kommerziellen Part: du verfolgst Angebote nach, behandelst kommerzielle Einwände und koordinierst den Vertragsabschluss. Du verstehst dich als umsatzorientierte Person, die sowohl strategisch denkt als auch operativ anpackt: New Business Experience: Du hast Erfahrung im B2B Sales und hast einen Sales-Prozess bereits end-to-end owned, von Pipeline Generation bis zum Vertragsabschluss. jobs.description: TALA has been on a rocket ship since its founding in 2019 by entrepreneur Grace Beverley. Built on largely organic social, today we are a digital-first, multichannel women’s activewear brand with a multifaceted growth and retention strategy. Following a £5m fundraise from world-class institutional investors and growing global media attention, TALA is entering an exciting new phase of growth, including the opening of two stores in London. Plan and manage delivery days around Bicester Village's service yard access and delivery windows, ensuring the team is resourced and ready ahead of every drop. Receive, check and book in all deliveries accurately and on the day of arrival, escalating discrepancies, shortages and damages to Logistics within agreed timeframes. Set and hold a clear delivery-to-floor turnaround standard Processing, Pricing & Retail Ready Own the "retail ready" standard end to end: steamed, sized, hung or folded, correctly hangered, security tagged, ticketed and floor-ready before it leaves the stockroom. Manage the outlet pricing and ticketing process with total accuracy, ensuring every unit carries the correct price and any was/now ticketing is applied in line with brand and regulatory guidelines. Execute promotional changes, markdowns and price changes to deadline, including overnight or pre-trade implementation where needed. Build simple, repeatable processing routines and workstation set-ups that let the team move at volume without losing accuracy. Track and improve processing productivity, using units-per-hour measures to plan labour and forecast the resource needed for peak drops. Stock Accuracy & Inventory Integrity Be the store's owner of stock file accuracy, treating the integrity of our data as a core deliverable rather than an admin task. Run a disciplined cycle counting programme across the store, prioritising high-value, high-volume and known problem lines. Investigate and resolve negative stock, unknown barcodes, duplicate barcodes and mis-scanning patterns, feeding root causes back to HQ rather than simply correcting the symptom. Lead the store's preparation for and execution of full stocktakes, including pre-count housekeeping, team briefing, counting discipline and post-count exception resolution. Own shrinkage performance for the store alongside the Store Manager, identifying loss drivers and putting practical controls in place. Replenishment & Trading Support Ensure the shop floor is fully sized and replenished at open, through the day and at close, so we never lose a sale to a size sitting in a box. Partner with the Store Manager on floor moves, launches and campaign execution, making sure stock is available in the right quantity at the right moment. Provide the Store Manager and Merchandising with clear, timely feedback on size and line performance, sell-through, over-stocks and gaps. Support omnichannel fulfilment activity in store, including click and collect and any in-store fulfilment we introduce, to the service levels we set. Backroom Management & Space Design and maintain a stockroom layout that works at volume: logical, labelled, densely but safely stored, and quick to pick from. Manage stockroom capacity actively, flagging space risk ahead of major intakes and working with HQ on solutions before it becomes a trading problem. Own backroom housekeeping, packaging management, waste and recycling, in line with TALA's sustainability commitments. Keep all equipment, consumables and ticketing supplies stocked and functioning. Ensure cash handling, banking, POS and daily operational routines are completed accurately and securely. Implement and embed the TALA Retail Playbook consistently, and feed back where it can be improved. jobs.title: Product & Business Analyst
jobs.description: Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product. This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally. Tasks Feature conceptualization . Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked. Requirements engineering . Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified. Sprint operations . Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made. UAT, QA and testing . Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs. Analytics and performance measurement . Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact? Requirements A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed. Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think. Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious. Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market. Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built. Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team. Nice to have Agile/Scrum exposure, ticket systems, manual QA or test-case experience, and an interest in music, education or marketplaces. Benefits Work directly with the VP Product in a dynamic, cross-functional team spanning Product, Marketing and Customer Success. Full end-to-end exposure: discovery, requirements, delivery, release, measurement and growth. A front-row seat at Europe's leading music education platform, with real breadth across very different product challenges. A modern, AI-first working culture. A high-visibility talent role with direct exposure to the leadership team and an attractive international career trajectory as we scale. We run a short, structured screening built around real examples of your work and how you think. Tell us who you are, why this role, and when you can start. We will take it from there. jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a Paid Social Specialist to join our UK&I Media team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing Paid Social marketing campaigns across multiple brands. You will play an important role in executing new campaigns and the wider strategy to grow the channel within our local structure for the UK & Ireland. You will be reporting directly to the Paid Social & Programmatic Lead, while working closely with other stakeholders in the UK&I Media team and across the wider UK&I cluster, including Marketing, Brand, Creative, AdTech teams and more. In order to drive successful campaigns, you will utilise all the latest solutions and tools from Paid Social platforms (including Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok, Reddit and similar). To succeed in this role, you need to be a self-driven and self-motivated individual - ready to work hands-on across multiple accounts. You will actively manage and optimise campaigns, whilst working closely with the team and expanding your digital marketing experience. The ideal candidate will be a positive and adaptable team player, with a problem-solving attitude, and good communication and presentation skills. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Executing and managing a wide range of Paid Social campaigns hands-on across multiple platforms (including Meta, Snapchat, X, TikTok, Reddit and similar), for all verticals (casino, live casino, sports betting) and multiple brands. Working closely with the team to analyse metrics from internal tools and platforms to track campaign performance and continuously optimise our accounts. Implementing new channel solutions and running regular A/B tests across our activity, aligned with the overall goals and KPIs. Building active collaboration with our key partners across external digital platform teams and tech vendors. Navigating complex tracking and attribution systems with the Media team and AdTech teams to maximise our measurement capabilities across the channel and expand our incrementality testing. Collaborating with Brand and Creative teams to ensure messaging and creatives are aligned across the funnel and utilise channel best practices. Ensuring full compliance with regional advertising regulations and other compliance standards. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: 1-2 years of experience in Paid Social or wider digital marketing role (client side or agency). Gaming industry experience will be considered a plus. Strong analytical mindset, confident in spotting opportunities for growth. Professional experience in using analytics tools will be considered a plus (Tableau/Looker, Google Analytics, Appsflyer or similar). Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Fluent English is essential for this role, both written and spoken. Having completed the UnternehmerTUM Incubator and a €3M project financed by SPRIN-D (German Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation), we successfully deployed two containerized pilot systems and are conducting validation projects with industrial partners. This is not a role where you reproduce something that already works. Parts of what you build will be the first of their kind, and some of them will fail. We are looking for someone who finds that interesting rather than alarming. You will sit close to the founding team and see how an early stage company actually runs: how decisions get made, what gets prioritised and why, and what a founder's week really looks like. Your measurements and your judgement feed directly into those decisions. Yet we treat it as though it were free: we use it once, contaminate it, and spend enormous amounts of energy trying to make it usable again. That is the problem we work on. We offer you a seat in the room where it gets solved: Iteration speed. Sketch a geometry in the morning, print it in the afternoon, test it the next day. You see the whole loop. CAD, print, assembly, measurement chain, data, and the report that goes to our partners. Direct collaboration with the founders. No layer in between, and ownership of your own components. The work is primarily on-site in Munich-Bogenhausen, with limited home office possible for tasks that allow it. jobs.title: Senior Go-to-Market Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über uns: Gute Entscheidungen entstehen selten von allein. Wir bauen die Software dafür. Valsight unterstützt Controlling- und Strategie-Teams dabei, schneller auf veränderte Marktbedingungen zu reagieren, indem sie binnen Sekunden Business-Treiber anpassen und Szenarien durchspielen können. Deshalb setzen führende DAX-Konzerne und mittelständische Unternehmen auf uns, darunter Siemens, Mercedes-Benz Group, Volkswagen und Commerzbank. Wir sind kein Konzern und kein frisches Seed-Startup. Wir sind genau dazwischen. Ein Team, das transparent arbeitet, schnell lernt und jeden Tag besser werden will. Über die Stelle: In dieser Rolle erzeugst du Nachfrage und überführst sie in qualifizierte Pipeline und Umsatz. Du setzt auf unserer bestehenden GTM-Strategie auf und bringst sie in die Umsetzung. Dabei bleibst du durchgehend hands-on. Du arbeitest über den gesamten Funnel. Dein Targeting ist account-based: du entscheidest, welche Accounts du wann mit welcher Botschaft ansprichst und baust daraus die passenden Kampagnen. Demand Generation und Vertrieb bringst du auf eine gemeinsame Linie und machst deine Wirkung über klare Kennzahlen sichtbar. In unserem AI-first-Umfeld hast du den Freiraum, dir die Tools und Strukturen aufzubauen, die du dafür brauchst. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben: Du verantwortest die Demand Generation und gewinnst verlässlich qualifizierte Leads. Dabei probierst du kontinuierlich Neues aus. Du priorisierst Accounts und spielst gezielte Kampagnen auf sie aus, abgestimmt auf Zeitpunkt und Botschaft. Du baust den Funnel vom ersten Touchpoint bis zur Übergabe an Sales, mit Conversion-Strecken ins CRM und A/B-Tests. Die B2B-Kampagnen entwickelst du und setzt sie selbst über Paid, Organic, Outbound und Lifecycle um. Nurturing-Flows und Automatisierungen entwickelst du eigenständig und nutzt AI dort als Hebel. Dabei unterstützen dich unsere internen AI-Expert:innen. Tracking und Reporting baust du selbst auf und steuerst datenbasiert nach. Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads und Marketing-Signale strukturiert an Sales und begleitest den Übergang zur Opportunity. Qualifikation Was du mitbringst: Du hast nachweisbar Pipeline im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld aufgebaut, idealerweise für eine erklärungsbedürftige Lösung mit langen Kaufzyklen. Account-based Marketing hast du bereits mehrfach selbst umgesetzt. Du weißt, welche Kanäle und Tools tragen und bringst sie hands-on zum Laufen. Datenbasiert zu entscheiden ist für dich selbstverständlich und du bist sicher im Umgang mit Kampagnen- und Pipeline-Kennzahlen. Marketing Automation, CRM und die Performance-Kanäle beherrschst du. Erfahrung mit AI-gestützten Workflows ist ein klarer Pluspunkt. Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und bist verhandlungssicher auf Englisch. Benefits Was wir dir bieten: Arbeite an relevanten Problemen: Unsere Software unterstützt Finance-Teams bei Siemens, Mercedes-Benz Group, Volkswagen, Commerzbank und weiteren Konzernen und Mittelständlern dabei, unter Unsicherheit bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen. Dein Marketing spricht genau diese Unternehmen an. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echtem Business Impact. Lerne schnell und arbeite AI-first: Wir nutzen AI als Teil unseres Arbeitsalltags für Recherche, Prototyping, Analyse, Kommunikation, Automatisierung und bessere Entscheidungen. Flexibles Arbeiten: Wir vertrauen dir, gute Arbeit zu leisten. Der Fokus liegt auf Ergebnissen, Zusammenarbeit und Verlässlichkeit. Dazu gehören hybrides Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub und ein halber Urlaubstag als Geschenk zu deinem Geburtstag. Lernen & Entwicklung: SaaS und AI verändern sich rasant, und wir uns mit ihnen. Deshalb investieren wir in Lernen und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Team & Austausch: Bei Valsight bekommst du Kontext, Vertrauen und Raum, Dinge voranzubringen. Wir arbeiten direkt und teamübergreifend zusammen und nutzen bewusst das Wissen aller. Weekly Shows, All-Hands mit Ask-Me-Anything und Team-Events machen genau das im Alltag sichtbar. jobs.title: Fachplaner Sanitär / Projektingenieur TGA (m/w/d) KG 410
jobs.description: Sanitärplanung bei BBP – mit Raum für gute Ingenieurarbeit Sie möchten wieder Zeit für gute TGA-Planung haben, statt sich zwischen Termindruck, Koordination und allem gleichzeitig aufzureiben? Dann könnte BBP das richtige Umfeld für Sie sein. In unserem 22-köpfigen TGA-Team sind Fachplaner, Projektleiter, Bauüberwachung sowie BIM-/CAD-Koordination eng miteinander verbunden. Für den Bereich Sanitär / KG 410 planen Sie bei uns Abwasser-, Wasser- und Gasanlagen sowie trockene Feuerlöschanlagen – und das für anspruchsvolle Neubau- und Sanierungsprojekte. Sie arbeiten in einem festen Projektteam gemeinsam mit der Projektleitung und den Fachplanern der Gewerke Heizung, Lüftung und Elektro. Die Projektkoordination übernimmt der Projektleiter , sodass Sie sich auf Ihre fachliche Aufgabe konzentrieren können. Durch eine vorausschauende Personal- und Kapazitätsplanung bleiben unsere Projekte planbar und schaffen den Freiraum für gute Ingenieurarbeit. Dabei erwartet Sie kein Alltag mit immer gleichen Standardprojekten: Bei BBP bearbeiten Sie unterschiedlichste Bestands- und Neubauprojekte – vom mehrgeschossigen Wohnungsbau über Schulen und Oberstufenzentren bis hin zu Polizeidienststellen, Büro- und Verwaltungsgebäuden. Seit über 35 Jahren begleiten wir anspruchsvolle Projekte. Rund 75 Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus sechs Fachdisziplinen arbeiten dabei gemeinsam an technischen Lösungen. Was uns auszeichnet, ist eine Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Erfahrene Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure teilen ihr Wissen und unterstützen sich gegenseitig. Auch Ihre fachliche Entwicklung kommt nicht zu kurz. Wir investieren gezielt in hochwertige Weiterbildungen und ermöglichen unter anderem die Qualifizierung zum zertifizierten Fachplaner bei EIPOS . Start: ab 01.10.2026 oder sobald Sie bereit sind. Aufgaben Sie übernehmen die Fachplanung für Wasser, Abwasser, Gas und trockene Feuerlöschanlagen und begleiten Ihr Gewerk über die relevanten Leistungsphasen hinweg. Dabei übernehmen Sie unter anderem: Planung der Kostegruppe 410 in den HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1–7, Entwicklung technisch und wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Lösungen, Erstellung von Berechnungen, Planunterlagen, Leistungsverzeichnissen und Kostenermittlungen, Abstimmung mit Behörden, Versorgern und den beteiligten Fachplanern, Kollissionsplanung und Schachtbelegung zu Heizung, Lüftung und Elektro, Begleitung Ihres Gewerks bis zur Vergabe, fachliche Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung der Planung. Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich, sind aber nie auf sich allein gestellt. Qualifikation Sie haben Erfahrung in der Planung von Wasser-, Abwasser- und Gasanlagen und möchten nach einer Einarbeitung eigenständig Projekte bearbeiten. Idealerweise bringen Sie mit: abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Versorgungstechnik, TGA, Energie-/Gebäude-/Umwelttechnik, Maschinenbau oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, alternativ eine technische Ausbildung bzw. Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung, Erfahrung mit den HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1–7, Kenntnisse der VDI 6026 sowie der relevanten technischen Regelwerke und Normen, sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Planungswerkzeugen, idealerweise AutoCAD und liNear, Erfahrung mit AVA-Software, Kenntnisse in Revit sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss, Freude an eigenständiger Planung und fachlichem Austausch. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Fraud & Risk
jobs.description: RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in. The Role We're looking for a Data Scientist to support product initiatives for RevenueCat Capital , with deep experience in lead qualification, anomaly detection, fraud prevention, and underwriting. This is a chance to be the founding Data Scientist embedded within the Capital team, a greenfield opportunity to scale our new fintech business lines from <$1M to $100M+. You'll partner directly with leadership, collaborate across teams, and bring a new product to life inside RevenueCat. Your work will touch real money, real developers, and a product that is just getting started. Read more about the opportunity here . The Opportunity: RC Capital RevenueCat is on a mission to help developers make more money. We build software that helps apps implement and manage purchases, with over 50% of new subscription apps on the App Store launching with RevenueCat. OpenAI's mobile subscriptions run on RC. Top of funnel metrics are up 300%+ YoY. RC Capital is our next chapter: we'll continue to help developers make more money, not just through software, but through financial products. Financial institutions would love to have what we already have: Trust + distribution: App developers already trust us in their purchase flow — the highest stakes moment in any user journey. Real-time, verifiable data: Cross-platform revenue plus leading indicators like installs, trials, conversions, and refunds. Unmatched industry insights: We know how apps earn money at scale, which improves underwriting and product design. Our first product is Daily Payouts : a factoring product that lets developers get app store proceeds sooner. Scaling it is a big challenge, but it’s just the beginning. There’s so much more to build: credit cards, revenue-based lending, cohort-based financing. We’ve got a mountain to climb. What you'll do Own the Data Science strategy for RC Capital. Build the foundation for our underwriting and fraud detection systems from the ground up. Nothing is locked in, you'll define the models, the signals, and the approach. Develop sophisticated models for lead qualification, anomaly detection, fraud prevention, and credit underwriting. All this using the richest, most real-time app revenue data in the world. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to integrate risk signals and underwriting logic into customer-facing flows and internal decisioning engines. Analyze cross-platform revenue data to uncover insights that improve our underwriting models and product design. Build mechanisms for measuring impact , evaluating model performance, and driving prioritization of new data initiatives. Operate with high ownership in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment helping to define the long-term vision for our financial products. About you You are a Senior Data Scientist who cares deeply about impact and has direct experience with the kind of models that carry real financial consequence. From a skills perspective, you bring: You have 5+ years of data science experience , ideally with a strong background in fintech, credit, lending, or payments. You have deep expertise in fraud and/or underwriting. You know how to build models that balance risk and growth, and you understand the nuances of financial data. You're highly analytical and technical. You are an expert in SQL and Python.

Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description: The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Qualification path No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description: TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. jobs.title: Product Engineer - AI Investing
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning. Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Starts from user problems, not feature lists. Can make decisions with incomplete information. Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. This Role Is Not For People who only write decks and do not drive execution. PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. People who launch features and then stop caring. PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: AI GTM Systems Specialist
jobs.description: Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals globally. We serve over 2,000 customers—including over 50% of the Fortune 100—across 30+ countries. At Quorum , our "product" isn't just our software; it’s our people. We are looking for a 100% remote AI GTM Systems Specialist who is a hands-on builder, systems thinker, and revenue growth driver. This isn't just an ops role—it’s an opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence powers the entire customer journey across our global Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy. The Impact You’ll Have As an AI GTM Systems Specialist, reporting directly to the Sr. Director of Demand Generation and Marketing Operations, you are the technical engine bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI capabilities and real-world revenue execution. You will design, deploy, and optimize agentic workflows that drive pipeline velocity—from account research and personalized outbound execution to CRM synchronization and deal support. By turning GTM friction into automated, high-performing AI solutions, you will directly influence Quorum ’s scalable growth and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Agentic Workflow Architecture: Build and maintain intelligent AI agents across the entire customer lifecycle, including campaign ideation, audience discovery, competitive intelligence, and account-based sales support. AI SDR Outbound Motion: Support day-to-day outbound execution—managing prospect list generation, waterfall enrichment (via Clay or equivalent platforms), sequencing, reply management, and seamless meeting hand-offs to Account Executives. AI Infrastructure & Tooling: Design prompt templates, tool definitions, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines over internal content libraries and CRM data using frameworks like Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, and MCP connectors. Production Operations & Guardrails: Implement safety protocols, PII protection, and content filtering; track token usage, latency, and costs; and monitor sending infrastructure (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) to guarantee high deliverability and regulatory compliance (CAN-SPAM/GDPR). Measurable Revenue Impact: Run performance experiments (A/B testing on prompts/workflows) and track core metrics—such as pipeline generated, meetings booked/held, time-to-first-touch, and AE time saved—to continuously optimize system outputs. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with frontline Sales, Marketing, and CS teams to translate operational pain points into clear AI initiatives, leading pilot programs and creating user enablement documentation. About You The Experienced Builder: You bring 1–3 years of hands-on experience building or operating AI/ML applications and LLM agentic workflows, coupled with 1–5 years in RevOps, Marketing Ops, or Sales Ops within a B2B SaaS environment. Technical & Tooling Savvy: You are proficient with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI), prompt engineering, basic Python, Clay, webhooks, and modern automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Salesforce, Marketo). You are comfortable working with tools like Claude Code and MCP connectors. jobs.source_id: bjak-Technical Product Lead, AI Email App
jobs.title: Technical Product Lead, AI Email App
jobs.description: About the Role There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things As Technical Product Lead, AI Email App, you work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and engineering constraints. You will work directly with ML and engineering teams to define how the system should behave, how we measure it, and how we continuously improve it. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You are expected to understand the system and challenge technical decisions. What You'll Own Define end-to-end requirements for AI capabilities, from model behavior to system behavior to user experience. Translate model capabilities, evaluation results, and technical constraints into clear product and system decisions. Make trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and UX. Work closely with ML, backend, and client engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration. Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback. Establish clear quality bars and feedback loops for AI-powered experiences. Drive execution through clear specifications, prioritization, and strong technical judgment. Identify failure modes and ensure AI systems behave predictably and recover gracefully. Own product quality end-to-end, correctness, reliability, usefulness, and user trust. What We're Looking For Technical Strong computer science fundamentals and system design skills. Solid understanding of modern ML and how AI systems behave in production. Comfortable reading technical designs, understanding architectures, and engaging deeply with engineers. Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, and failure modes. Product & AI Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end. Hands-on experience with AI-powered products, particularly LLM-based systems. Experience with model evaluation, experimentation, prompting, or AI system iteration. Ability to turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, measurable outcomes, and executable plans. Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions when the right answer is not obvious. Mindset Highly technical, curious, and comfortable going deep. Strong bias toward shipping, experimentation, and learning from real-world usage. Able to challenge engineers and researchers constructively while maintaining strong collaboration. Comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving, zero-to-one environment. Nice to have Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products. Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager. Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems. Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling. Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments. An engineering background is a strong plus, but what matters most is the ability to reason deeply about both AI systems and product outcomes . Outcomes Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities. AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users. Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty. Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback. Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction. How We Work We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, AI Email App
jobs.description: About the Role There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things As Lead Software Engineer, AI Email Apps, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers. This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales. What You'll Own Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop. Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling. Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences. Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship. Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience. Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence. Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences. Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale. What We're Looking For Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems. Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production. Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities. Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information. Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one. A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage. High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals. Outcomes Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load. Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience. Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably. Latency and reliability improve measurably over time. How We Work We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently. We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional. Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: US Healthcare Professionals: Interview On Medication Selection
jobs.description: What We're Researching We're running a paid study on how clinical providers approach medication selection and therapeutic recommendations. Understanding the factors that drive prescribing choices helps us map the real-world workflow of modern patient care. This research aims to identify the clinical, logistical, and patient-specific variables that influence treatment paths. How It Works During a remote video session, you will participate in a moderated conversation about your clinical workflow. We will ask you to walk through recent examples of how you evaluate different medication options for your patients. You will review a series of hypothetical patient scenarios and explain your reasoning for recommending specific treatments. Finally, you will provide feedback on the primary challenges you face when ordering or prescribing therapies. Who This Is For We are looking for US-based physicians and healthcare professionals with active prescribing authority. We welcome attendings, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and clinical specialists who regularly make medication recommendations. Ideal candidates will have hands-on experience navigating treatment selection and ordering therapies within the past year. What You'll Do Walk us through your current workflow for evaluating and selecting patient medications Discuss the primary factors that influence your clinical recommendations Review hypothetical patient scenarios and explain your treatment choices Share insights on the challenges associated with prescribing and ordering therapies Who Should Apply Active US-based physician or healthcare professional Current authority or influence over medication selection and prescribing Recent clinical experience ordering therapies or making treatment recommendations Comfortable discussing patient care workflows in a remote video setting Compensation $175 one-time Ready to participate? To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca . Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The role As an Account Manager, you build your own portfolio of business owners and help them navigate their financial journey with iwoca . Your work directly contributes to the financial success of iwoca and the customer experience. From independent hair salons to established dental practices, you will ensure our customers feel supported, heard, and empowered to grow. The requirements Essential: Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use. Guide & Assist: Support new customers through their application journey, simplifying complex steps and finding the right financial solutions for their business goals. Collaborate: Work within an international, cross-functional team to improve our processes and help us scale our mission. You might be the right fit if: You are a People Person: You genuinely enjoy connecting with others and are motivated by seeing your clients succeed. You can multitask effectively while maintaining a high standard of service and a positive tone. jobs.description: Salary: USD 2,100 to USD 4,300 per month, based on location and experience Hours: Full overlap with EST, 9am to 5pm. This role is client facing. The role  You manage a team of accountants and a portfolio of eCommerce client files. You review their work, run month-end to a five-day close, and talk to founders directly. Must have Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field 5+ years in accounting, in a firm or multi-client environment 2+ years reviewing or managing other accountants' work In-depth, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online or Xero. You can do the work yourself, not just review it. English at B2 level or above, written and spoken. You will be client-facing. Nice to have A professional accounting qualification: ACCA, CPA, CA, CIMA, ACA, Contador Publico, or your country's equivalent. In progress counts. eCommerce or consumer goods clients Inventory and COGS experience QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification FP&A or financial modelling ClickUp or similar project management tools What you will do Manage and review the work of a team of accountants Own full-cycle accounting across multiple client files Run month-end close on a five-day cycle Review financials before they reach the client, for logic as well as accuracy Give direct feedback to your team and follow up on it Handle client conversations, including delays and bad news Improve processes and identify automation opportunities What the job actually looks like Month-end is the most demanding period of the month and falls within the first ten business days. Some of our processes are mature, and others are still being built. When you hit a gap, we expect you to help close it.
